issues.description: The Person.first name field identifier is inconsistent between repositories: the template and tests use the identifier/field name 'firstName' (and corresponding getters/setters), while the solution's Person class declares the backing field as 'forename' but its getters/setters and equals/hashCode still reference 'firstName'. This discrepancy will cause compilation errors in the solution and will confuse students mapping the problem/tests to the model.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across all artifacts. Rename the field in solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java from 'forename' to 'firstName' (or alternatively update all getters/setters and tests to use 'forename'), and ensure equals(), hashCode(), and any references use the same identifier. Prefer using 'firstName' to match template and tests.
